0022600107.text: The Houston Rockets (2-0, 1st in the Southwest) visit the Atlanta Hawks (2-0, 1st in the Southeast, 1st in the East), with both teams unbeaten so far this season and the Rockets 1-0 on the road. Houston is missing Fred VanVleet (knee), Marcus Smart (forearm strain) and Steven Adams (ankle), while Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Rockets won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 117-95 win in Houston on March 20, 2026.
